description: This script sets up a series of Git tests related to CRLF and LF line ending normalization and merge conflict detection, particularly focusing on how the 'text=auto' attribute and related Git configurations handle line ending conflicts and renormalization during merges.

methods.name: compare_files
methods.description: Compares two files after transforming their line endings to ensure consistency, used for verifying merge results.

methods.name: fuzz_conflict
methods.description: Normalizes conflict markers in a file for fuzzy conflict detection.
